comment: These three CVs add to their knobs and the total is clamped, unlike CHI-X's filter CVs which replace the knob. The sumRange on the threshold jack is the dB scale the knob is marked in, not a voltage at the jack. SHAPE returns from process() before it reads the expander whenever its bypass button is on (src/Shape.cpp:768-778), so nothing here does anything in that state. The HARD GATE jack has no attenuverter.
